in_marathi.name: Basavaraja
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Basa (Lord of Basaveshwara)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Basavaraja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Basavaraja is a Sanskrit name composed of two parts: 'Basava' and 'Raja'. 'Basava' refers to the Lord of Basaveshwara, a form of Lord Shiva. 'Raja' means king. Hence, Basavaraja is the king of Lord Basaveshwara.
